The '''Almak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almak/Legends|Almak]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Leffingite/Legends|Leffingite]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was located in this system.
